name: Seirei-sama wa Haramigoro ~Kanojo o Sukuu Kozukuri Vacation~
original_name: 精霊さまは孕みごろ ～彼女を救う子づくりばけ～しょん～
source:
Keigo was trying to get through his summer break without any romantic issues come up. However, during this summer, his uncle, involved in trading, returned home to Japan. He brings Keigo a charm: a small glass bottle, which contained a young, female water spirit, who he saves.

Separated from her home, the young spirit's very soul was on the verge of vanishing...and the only way to keep her soul from vanishing is to bear a child with a human being! Thus, she asks Keigo to impregnate her.

This is how Keigo came to live with a beautiful water spirit and have the very best (and very luckiest) summer of his life!

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE032257.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
圭吾試圖過個不必為感情煩惱的暑假。然而，今年夏天，從事貿易的叔叔回到了日本。他給圭吾帶來了一個護身符：一個小玻璃瓶，裡面裝著一位叔叔救下的年輕水精靈少女。

離開了家鄉，水精靈少女眼看就要消失……唯一能保住性命的辦法，就是和人類生下孩子！因此，她請求圭吾讓她懷孕。

就這樣，圭吾與美麗的水精靈一起生活，並度過了他一生中最美好的（也是最幸運的）夏天！
